parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1075189 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require compound_structures as an INNER JOIN. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID.
